title: Collectibles
description: Every single collectible with a real coordinate: the three sets of docs/gdd/01 (120 archive photos of Khải to re-shoot, 40 subsidy-era ration coupons to find, 60 old signs to photograph). This is the game's second map: the reason to ride every district. Coordinates come from landmarks.json or the centroid of the named street in the Overture/OSM road graph (coords_source).

description.description: What the player sees in the album once found; for photos, what is in the old frame.

year.description: Year the photo was taken / coupon issued / sign painted.

landmark.description: landmarks:<id> the item sits at (within ~50 m).

street.description: Overture/OSM street name the coordinate was taken from.

hours.description: Photos: hours of day in which the light matches the old frame.

archive_frame.description: Photos: id used by missions' steps[].archive_frame (khai_<year>_<nnn>_<slug>).

unlocks_tape.description: Photos: cassette number (1-24) that plays once this frame is matched. Tape 24 also opens by story (docs/gdd/02 §11).

hidden_in.description: Coupons: where the runtime hides it near the coordinate.

activity.description: activities:<id> whose loop collects this set.
